objects.name: connector_sync_state
objects.purpose: current monotonic cursor revision and active-run fence

invariants: only one active synchronization run may own a connector state fence
checkpoint revisions are append-only and monotonic per connector
same connector/idempotency key with different request hash is rejected
resume continues from the last durable cursor
compensation creates a new checkpoint and never rewrites history
compensation is rejected when a newer run has advanced the connector
raw cursor values are server-internal and are not exposed by public HTTP responses
provider credentials and raw provider payloads are not stored in synchronization state
